newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends at 29 pct in late surge.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends at 29 pct in late surge.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate extended earlier gains to close 520 basis points up at 29.0 percent as some dealers witheld money and speculated ahead of the close, dealers said.

"Market liquidity dried up towards the close. They hid their money and made us close at session highs," said one trader. "Apart from speculation at the close, we traded at a calmer (average of around) 27 percent for most of the session," he added.
Traders pointed out that overnight rates had gained in part due to correcting after Wednesday's low close.
Traders said that the relative recovery in the peso helped keep overnight rates stable for most of the session. The benchmark 48-hour peso closed 6.2 centavos firmer at 7.7100/7.7230 per dollar.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile closed sharply up in tandem with government paper, higher by 685 basis points to 29.54 percent.
Total credit maturities of 7.895 billion pesos were expected on Friday, but traders said ensuing liquidity shortages could be offset by government spending.
